up: Return all exact activity records for assay CHEMBL4808149. For each activity, report the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and the exact activity value (standard_value). Do not summarize or deduplicate by compound; return one row per activity record.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4808149'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
